name: TTVDropBot
description: Twitch Drop Bot. Automatically farms every Twitch Drop available like Rust for you and now also your Custom Channels.

ttvdropbot_token.description: Your Twitch auth token. Leave empty on the first deploy and get it with: node ./build/index.js --showtoken (see readme).

ttvdropbot_games.description: Priority list of games separated by spaces. Use _ instead of spaces inside a game name (e.g. Rust Lost_Ark).
